purpose: 108-world prespecified replication; unchanged E0/EUR/EA model factors and B1/B2/B3; no product promotion

factors.E0: Unchanged deterministic forecasts, small reference field, nonlinear internal management
factors.EUR: Uncertainty plus larger reference sample; fixed primary candidate
factors.EA: EUR with fixed additive internal lineup planning instead of nonlinear planning

reference_scope: Increase samples from the SAME baseline roster mixture; no claim of greater roster diversity
audit_manager_scope: Every draft strategy receives the same management for a given audit. ADDITIVE uses original public means. CATEGORY_EXPECTED uses the shared EUR public forecast model, independent implementation, and no actual opponent data.
randomness: New public seed namespace; disjoint forecast/reference/audit namespaces; identical player-period outcomes across counterfactuals
primary_outcome: Realized synthetic each-category share, mean across opponents then seats then generated leagues
failure_policy: Report all distinct failed drafts; exclude the entire paired seat across all strategies, separately for each common management policy
interval_method: 4000-resample stratified paired league-cluster percentile bootstrap; exploratory intervals are descriptive and not adjusted for multiple contrasts
promotion: Not eligible; no real seasons, no parameter tuning; previous historical gates retained
unsupported_scope: IR and participation minima in this independent audit
revisions_after_audit: None permitted under this experiment ID
inference: One primary EUR-vs-B3 comparison; all other intervals descriptive and not multiplicity adjusted. Do not promote a default based on observed winner.
precision: 108 generated leagues (three times previous 36), 12 per stratum. No historical power claim; subgroup mean-loss criterion is a research screen, not proof of harm.
frozen_candidate_rule: Keep all v0.3.3 E0, EUR and EA construction parameters unchanged. No new draft score in this version.
audit_namespace: AUDIT_M034_OUTCOMES; unobserved role uses auditor-only M034_AUDIT_ROLE_FACTORS

role_diagnostic.selection: ALL 12 public seeds, not loss-selected; reuse committed drafts; public league remains cluster

numerical_diagnostic.states: FIRST/MIDDLE/LAST user picks from EUR committed draft; selection does not depend on outcomes
numerical_diagnostic.scope: Conditional Monte Carlo convergence at fixed field and projection scenarios, not predictive validity; do not choose runtime default from these 12 states
